financials_interim.notes: Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026), same filing as GROUP row (p.3-4,6), COMPANY (parent, standalone holding-company) basis. Company has no trading revenue of its own (a pure holding company); operating_profit = -1,776 (admin expenses only, no revenue). PBT=-1,575 vs -606 in 30.06.2025; both periods are losses at the parent-only level, immaterial in scale, driven purely by holding-company overheads not offset by dividend income this quarter. EPS printed as -0.01 for the period (vs printed as nil for the 30.06.2025 quarter) -- ties: -1,575,000 / 189,689,990 shares = -0.0083, rounds to -0.01. total_liabilities = total_assets - total_equity = 2,830,680-2,826,464 = 4,216 ~= printed 4,215 (rounding). No inventory, no short/long-term borrowings at Company level (all blank/nil, none disclosed). shares_in_issue same combined 189,689,990 (dual-class) as Group -- Company EPS/NAPS both computed on this base per Note 4/5.

Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026 = period ended, since this is the first quarter of the FYE-March fiscal year), p.3 income statement, p.4 balance sheet, p.6 cash flow. GROUP basis. operating_profit = 'Profit/(Loss) from Operations' (338,879) which already nets Other Operating Income (52,670); cost_of_sales/gross_profit are the filing's own lines. profit_before_tax bridge verified: 338,879 (operating) + 131,438 (net finance income) + 14,372 (FV gain on FVTPL investments) = 484,689 ~= 484,690 (printed PBT) -- ties. IMPORTANT extraction-order correction: the 'Fair Value Gain/(Loss) on Investments' row's raw PDF text extracts with the two years apparently reversed vs the header order; the correct assignment (14,372 for 30.06.2026, 306,291 for 30.06.2025) was confirmed via this PBT bridge and via the cash flow statement's adjustment line 'Fair Value Gain from Investment - Measured at FVTPL (14,372) (306,291)', both of which corroborate 14,372=2026, 306,291=2025 -- the value used here. Tax expense 2026=77,655; the 30.06.2025 comparator column shows nil tax (blank), i.e. PAT2025=PBT2025 exactly (426,681=426,681), consistent with zero tax that quarter. Similarly, two balance-sheet SUBTOTAL rows ('Total Non-Current Assets' and 'Total Current Liabilities') print their two date-columns in reversed order relative to the header and relative to their own component lines above them (verified by summing each subtotal's component lines, which sum correctly to the OTHER printed number, not the one aligned under the 30.06.2026 header) -- this does not affect any field stored here since current_assets (16,319,020, unreversed, verified against Operational Review text on p.2 which states 'Total Current Assets were Rs. 16,319Mn ... as at 30th June 2026') and current_liabilities were cross-checked by re-summing their own unambiguous component lines: current_liabilities (30.06.2026) = Trade & Other Payables 1,111,684 + Interest Bearing Borrowings Due Within One Year 3,582,684 + Current Lease 33,219 + Income Tax Payable 77,792 + Bank Overdraft 189,449 = 4,994,828 ~= 4,994,827 (the SECOND, not first, printed number on that garbled subtotal row). Total Liabilities (6,965,327) and Total Assets (28,645,343) rows themselves are NOT reversed and tie exactly: 1,970,499 (non-current liab, unreversed) + 4,994,827 (current liab, corrected) = 6,965,326 ~= 6,965,327; 6,965,327 + 21,680,016 (total equity) = 28,645,343 = total assets. Total equity (21,680,016) includes NCI (11,707,337); owners' equity alone is 9,972,679, matching Operational Review's 'Rs.9,973Mn'. short_term_borrowings = Interest Bearing Borrowings Due Within One Year (3,582,684) + Bank Overdraft (189,449) = 3,772,133 (no single dedicated 'short-term borrowings' line exists separate from these two, so both are combined as short-term debt, consistent with the KVAL precedent in this DB). long_term_borrowings = Interest Bearing Borrowings Due After One Year (38,888) only; the non-current lease obligation (202,262) is excluded as it is a lease liability, not conventional debt. cash_and_equivalents = 'Cash and Cash Equivalent' balance-sheet line only (1,866,634); there is also Rs.4,149,363k in 'Short Term Investments in Deposits' and a Rs.189,449k bank overdraft -- the cash flow statement's own 'Cash and Cash Equivalents at end of period' concept (5,826,549) nets deposits and overdraft together, but the balance-sheet line item is used here for a literal, citable figure. shares_in_issue = 165,488,271 voting + 24,201,719 non-voting = 189,689,990 (dual-class share structure; EPS is computed on this combined base per the filing's own Note 4). capex = Acquisition of PPE (204,578) + Acquisition of Biological Assets (2,985) = 207,563, which equals the period's entire 'Net Cash Used in Investing Activities' (207,563) since there was no other investing item (Construction of/Additions to Investment Property = nil this period). Segment detail (p.7): Agri Food Exports segment result swung from a Rs.8,973k LOSS to a Rs.124,586k PROFIT (the single largest positive swing behind the 58.8% rise in operating profit); Consumer Brands segment profit fell 65.0% (Rs.83,134k to Rs.29,110k); Investment segment profit (which captures most of the FV gain/finance income) fell 28.1% (Rs.352,520k to Rs.253,339k) -- consistent with the FV-gain collapse noted above. Identity checks: PBT-tax=PAT ties (484,690-77,655=407,035); total_assets=total_liab+total_equity ties exactly (28,645,343=6,965,327+21,680,016).
